title: iammojogo's Entity HealthBar Mod
description: Shows health bars above all nearby entities with configurable distance, scaling, and display options.
body:
Shows health bars above all nearby entities with configurable distance, scaling, and display options.

There is an extra gui in game that you will LOVE! Its for extra UI stuff related to teh healthbar. ;) Extras shall we say?

🔧 COMPATIBILITY

Works with JEI, JourneyMap, Xaero's Minimap, Optifine, and most client-side mods.

Requirements:

Compatability: Minecraft correct version, forge at least from the last five versions.
